note: Set B is a strict subset of Set A: all 24 of its claims appear identically in A, and A adds one further claim — the W10X15 section for the D5 floor beam at Grid 5 — which the detail supports. That extra claim is correct and non-trivial, so A captures more of the page's engineering content with no additional errors. Both sets share the same weaknesses (vague 'beam opening'/'beam' entities, a duplicated 5'-0"/5 ft length for the Grid 4 beam, and a couple of dimensions apparently bound to the wrong beam).
remarks: Shared problems in both sets: 3'-7" appears in the B4 (FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 3) detail but is claimed for FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 5; the 10" values are the beam depth of the W10X15 section, yet are claimed as 'opening length' (Grid 5) and 'edge distance' (beam opening); 'opening/spacing | dimension | 3 ft | segment 1' is too vague to verify; the Grid 4 beam length is stated twice (5'-0" and 5 ft) and its 6" height duplicates the opening-height claim. Entities like 'beam opening', 'beam', 'opening/spacing' should be tied to the specific detail (A4/B4/C4/D5/E6 etc.). The 1/2" RADIUS edge-condition note from the general sheet notes is not claimed by either set.
